sources.entry: Willow Voice - AI dictation with automatic editing, style-matching, and noise optimization.

summary.name: Willow Voice
summary.one_liner: Willow Voice is AI voice dictation software that turns speech into formatted text in any app on Mac, Windows, and iPhone.
use_cases: Writing emails and Slack replies by voice
Voice typing in code editors like Cursor
Dictating messages in WhatsApp or iMessage
summary.what_it_does: Willow runs a hotkey-driven workflow: place the cursor in any text field, hold the hotkey and speak, and formatted text appears where the cursor is. It removes filler words, fixes punctuation, and applies formatting automatically. Its style-matching feature learns the user's tone over time across email, Slack, docs, and technical tools. An auto-learning dictionary keeps names, product terms, and abbreviations accurate, and Shortcuts let users save frequently used phrases as short commands. The page also describes a "Willow Scribe" feature that turns rough spoken descriptions into polished writing.
notable: Context-aware formatting and style-matching that adapts to the user's tone
Offline mode that runs entirely on the device
Claims SOC 2 Type II certification and HIPAA compliance with zero data retention and end-to-end encryption
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Accuracy and speed claims (3x more accurate than built-in dictation, 200ms text appearance) are the vendor's own claims and are not independently verified on the page
Offline mode is listed as a feature but its platform availability is not specified
